__comment: The held pose while the hose is actively spraying. Same flat sprite as hose.json, but the held display transforms pitch the model ~90 degrees forward so the nozzle points down the player's aim instead of up/sideways - that's what makes the stream read as leaving the nozzle tip. Only the held transforms are overridden; ground/gui/head fall through to item/generated. The X-rotation is the 'forward' pitch; nudge these rotation/translation values a few units in-game to line the nozzle up exactly.
